Read: src/components/shared/newsletter-signup.tsx

Report: Does the newsletter section in our Next.js match the Webflow version? What are the differences in background, padding, heading, layout?

Report: Does our BetaCta match? What are the visual differences?

## 3. Careers Hero Section
Read: src/components/careers/careers-hero.tsx
Read: src/components/careers/careers-hero.module.css

Then read boldteq-v1-0.webflow/careers.html lines 336-500 to find the careers hero section.

Report differences in text content, background, padding, badge.

## 4. Our Mission Sections
Read: src/components/our-mission/mission-hero.tsx
Read: src/components/our-mission/mission-delivery.tsx
Read: src/components/our-mission/delivery-standards.tsx
Read boldteq-v1-0.webflow/our-mission.html lines 336-600.

Report any structural or content differences.

## 5. Testimonials Section Content
Read: src/lib/constants/testimonials.ts
Read: boldteq-v1-0.webflow/testimonials.html lines 336-500 to find testimonial data.

Report if testimonials content matches (names, titles, quotes).

Keep responses focused on differences, not on what matches. Max 500 words total.

Now I have enough information. Let me compile my findings into a concise audit report focusing on differences.

## Component Audit Report: Next.js vs Webflow

**1. NEWSLETTER SIGNUP**
- **Match Status:** Nearly identical structure and content
- **Differences Found:** None critical. Both versions have:
  - "Join 500+ Subscribers" badge with sparkle icon
  - "Agency Growth Insights Delivered Monthly" heading
  - Matching description text
  - Email input + "Get Started" button
  - Privacy guarantee footer
- **CSS Styling:** Next.js uses CSS modules with identical spacing, colors, and layout. Background gradient (#092854 to #092955ab) matches Webflow.

**2. BETA CTA SECTION**
- **Match Status:** Content mismatch detected
- **Key Differences:**
  - Next.js: Shows "🔒 Exclusive Access" + "Private Beta Pricing" as popup modal AND separate inline section
  - Webflow (pricing.html): Contains only "Need Something More Flexible?" custom plan CTA - NO beta pricing section visible in lines 1138-1171
  - Next.js BetaCta component promotes "15 agencies" limit, founding pricing, with "Join the Beta" button
  - Webflow custom plan section uses different messaging ("Flexible capacity", "Custom turnaround") and links to contact.html
- **Structural Difference:** Next.js has popup trigger + inline section dual implementation; Webflow appears to have removed beta messaging in favor of custom plans on pricing page

**3. CAREERS HERO**
- **Match Status:** Content and structure aligned
- **Differences Found:** Minor wording variation only
  - Webflow (line 346): "We Set a Higher Standard" (exact match in Next.js)
  - Webflow subtitle uses "responsibility shapes how we hire" language (matches Next.js)
  - Gallery: Webflow shows 5 gallery card slots but hides cards 3-4; Next.js shows only 3 defined images with responsive stagger
- **Badge:** Both use "Careers At Boldteq" with cyan gradient

**4. OUR MISSION SECTIONS**
- **Match Status:** Content matches well with layout differences
- **Key Differences:**
  - Next.js mission-hero: 4 stat badges in grid (White-Label, Senior-Level, Structured, Agency-First)
  - Webflow mission-hero: Same 4 badges, but renders in different grid layout (mobile responsive 2-grid vs Next.js responsive grid)
  - Webflow "Why We Built" section duplicates paragraph text (lines 380-382: paragraph appears twice)
  - Next.js removes this duplication, shows cleaner content
  - Delivery section matches exactly (5 bullet points, same structure)

**5. TESTIMONIALS**
- **Status:** Content mismatch is severe
- **Critical Difference:**
  - Webflow testimonials.html (lines 336-378): Shows repeated "Sabrina" from "Modash" placeholder quote ("Hey Design just keeps getting better...") repeated 3 times
  - Next.js testimonials.ts: Contains 6 unique testimonials with varied names (Marcus H., Priya S., Jordan M., Caitlin R., Daniel K., Sarah L.) and unique quotes specific to Boldteq
  - Webflow appears to have placeholder/test data; Next.js has production copy

**Summary:** Newsletter and Careers components are production-ready. BetaCta has strategy divergence (beta vs custom plans). Mission section has minor content duplication in Webflow. Testimonials section in Webflow is still using placeholder test data while Next.js has finalized copy.
